natural.label: Natural
natural.description: Feels like a real person replying naturally. Safe and versatile for most situations.
natural.example: I feel the same about this — it really comes down to execution.

friendly.label: Friendly
friendly.description: Warm and empathetic. Good for softening tone and encouraging interaction.
friendly.example: I totally get where you're coming from, and this really does resonate.

professional.label: Professional
professional.description: Clear, restrained, and information-dense. Best for rational or industry discussion.
professional.example: That’s a fair take, though the real variable may still be execution.

sharp.label: Sharp
sharp.description: Direct and opinionated, but still controlled and publishable.
sharp.example: The issue isn’t the surface — the logic underneath was off from the start.

witty.label: Witty
witty.description: Adds a bit of humor and contrast without becoming too cheesy.
witty.example: This is one of those decisions that future-you will definitely remember.

analytical.label: Analytical
analytical.description: Focuses on logic, assumptions, and implications. Useful for viewpoint breakdowns.
analytical.example: Once you follow that premise through, the conclusion becomes pretty inevitable.

tvb.label: TVB Style
tvb.description: A touch of familiar commentary and light drama, like a punchy Hong Kong TV line.
tvb.example: The way you put it only makes me more curious about what comes next.

translated.label: Translated Style
translated.description: Reads like polished translated Chinese: restrained, neat, and slightly literary in rhythm.
translated.example: This may well be the part that proves hardest to ignore.

japanese-translated.label: JP Subtitle Style
japanese-translated.description: Gentle, restrained, and slightly subtitle-like in rhythm.
japanese-translated.example: I see… that really does make it hard to simply look away, doesn’t it?

qiongyao.label: Melodramatic
qiongyao.description: More emotional and polished in wording, but still kept short and reply-friendly.
qiongyao.example: In this single sentence, there is something both sharp and strangely tender.

deadpan.label: Deadpan
deadpan.description: Calm on the surface, with a subtle layer of dry humor underneath.
deadpan.example: Yeah, that sounds like a plan that definitely cannot go wrong.

classical-chinese.label: Classical Chinese
classical-chinese.description: Adds a touch of old-style elegance and brevity while staying understandable at a glance.
classical-chinese.example: 此言固是，然其后患亦不可不察。

taiwan-drama.label: Taiwan Drama
taiwan-drama.description: Gentle and emotionally layered, like a short line from a Taiwanese drama.
taiwan-drama.example: You know if you say it like that, I’m only going to care even more.

dongbei.label: Dongbei Style
dongbei.description: Straightforward, lively, and chatty like a familiar conversation.
dongbei.example: Man, the second you said that, the whole vibe just clicked.

headteacher.label: Headteacher
headteacher.description: Sounds like serious advice with a mildly lecturing tone, but still means well.
headteacher.example: I’m telling you this now so one day you’ll understand why it mattered.

web-novel.label: Web Novel
web-novel.description: Adds a little dramatic hook and page-turning energy to a short reply.
web-novel.example: At that moment, the real story had only just begun.

euro-translated.label: Euro Translation
euro-translated.description: Slightly formal and literary, like translated European prose in Chinese.
euro-translated.example: This was not an accident, but a drift that was almost destined to happen.

ceo.label: CEO Style
ceo.description: Confident, forceful, and in control, like a short statement that owns the room.
ceo.example: We’re done debating this — from here, we execute.

tsundere.label: Tsundere
tsundere.description: Sounds dismissive on the surface, but secretly caring underneath.
tsundere.example: Don’t get the wrong idea — you just happened to be right this time.

internet-mouthpiece.label: Internet Mouthpiece
internet-mouthpiece.description: Feels like the exact line everyone wanted to say but didn’t type first.
internet-mouthpiece.example: You basically just posted the one sentence everyone else was thinking.

leader-speech.label: Leader Speech
leader-speech.description: Formal and directional, like a short summary with a bit of authority.
leader-speech.example: The direction is clear now — what matters next is disciplined execution.

cyber-priest.label: Cyber Priest
cyber-priest.description: A little solemn, mystical, and prophetic, like digital-age sermon energy.
cyber-priest.example: The data has already delivered its revelation; the rest is only a matter of time.
